_comment: Plain supervised CTC (greek_asr.models.ctc): log-mel, 4x conv subsampling, 4-layer BiLSTM, character CTC, trained from scratch. max_steps stays null until a measured pilot fixes the budget; pass --max-steps for measurement runs (recorded as max_steps_source=cli).
architecture: conv2d x2 (stride 2) + BiLSTM 4x320 + linear CTC head
primary_sources: Graves et al. (2006), Connectionist Temporal Classification, ICML
Amodei et al. (2016), Deep Speech 2, ICML
